completion_scope: Ephemeral fail-closed browser action plan bound to an exact tab, document, origin and trusted gesture without Chrome transport dispatch
head_semantics: head_sha is the exact implementation commit tested locally and by CI; the later containing receipt/catalog commit requires its own exact-head CI and is recorded in the draft PR body

preflight.confirmed_gap: Existing capture routes guard individual effects, but no unified one-use contract bound a registered action to exact tab, document and origin before transport
preflight.owner_audit: background.js remains the capture and Chrome effect owner; the new module owns only an in-memory pre-transport plan and creates no alternate queue or persistent store

verified_facts: activeTab is temporary access granted by an explicit user gesture and is revoked on cross-origin navigation or tab close
MessageSender supplies tab, documentId and origin for source validation
scripting targets an exact tab and requires activeTab or host permission
messages from content scripts require validation because their sender context is less trusted

fixture_coverage.second_request_on_same_grant: denied while exact replay is idempotent

owner_preservation.library: existing items/content_fts and Chrome records unchanged
owner_preservation.job_queue: existing jobs/job_events and Core claim owner unchanged
owner_preservation.browser_effects: background.js remains the only existing Chrome capture effect owner and was not changed

tests.command: python3 -m unittest discover -s content-lab -p 'test_*.py' -v && node --test agent-bridge/*.test.mjs && node --test one-click-context/tests/*.test.*
tests.phase: test iteration 2 on exact implementation tree

limits: This is a pre-transport contract, not installed-browser qualification or UI wiring.
The in-memory registry intentionally loses grants on extension restart.
F-30 must independently verify installed Chrome handshake, reconnect, revoke and exact package hash.
No arbitrary click, navigation, selector, script or page-provided command is registered.
No related CAND item is automatically closed.
next_job: Re-audit installed-browser transport owners and qualify handshake, reconnect, revoke and exact package hash without expanding the registered F-29 action set.
